To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a cationic zinc complex has been successfully prepared by sonochemical method.
The ultrasound-assisted synthesis of [Zn(L)NO3]NO33 is a simple and rapid method to obtain the desired cationic zinc complex.
the morphology and size of zinc nitrate complexes have been successfully controlled by changing the reaction conditions.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the synthesis of a new nanostructured zinc nitrate complex by ultrasound irradiation, which has been characterized by single crystal and powder X-ray diffraction, scanning electron microscopy and NMR spectroscopic techniques.
the development of an easy and green approach to prepare a new cation zinc nitrate complex and its calcination to produce zinc oxide nanostructure with different morphologies.
synthesis, characterization and investigation of different factors on morphological properties of a new cations complex.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
sonication power and the concentration of reactants are the most important parameters in the synthesis of zinc nitrate and zinc oxide nanostructures.

the morphology of the synthesized zinc nitrate complexes is strongly dependent on the concentration of reactants and sonication power and also the calcination of the synthesized zinc complex leads to the production of zinc oxide nanostructures.
the morphology of the zinc nitrate complex is dependent on the reaction temperature, the initial reactant concentration, and the sonication power.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the sonication power has the highest effect on the size and morphology of the zinc nitrate complex, and the calcination of the complex at 400 °C led to formation of zinc oxide nanoparticles with the average size of 20–30 nm.
ultrasound-assisted synthesis is an efficient and rapid method for preparation of a new cations zinc nitrate complex.
ultrasound-assisted synthesis of zinc nitrate complexes is a simple and efficient route to produce nanostructured zinc oxide.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the sonication power has a significant effect on the morphology and size of synthesized complex.
the sonication process is an effective method for the synthesis of zinc nitrate complexes with different morphology and size.
ultrasound-assisted synthesis of metal complexes with Schiff base ligands is a facile and efficient approach for preparation of metal complexes with desired morphology and nanostructure.
